title: The Salted Pie
scene: At 1:20 PM, the dining car's apple pie was found full of salt, not sugar. The train was in a tunnel from 1:10 to 1:25.

suspects.name: Greta Lund
suspects.testimony: I was rolling dough in the galley from 1:10 to 1:30. I left the pie cooling on the rack.
suspects.alibiProof: The galley camera shows her rolling dough nonstop from 1:10 to 1:30.

suspects.name: Milo Baxter
suspects.testimony: I was punching tickets in carriage four around 1:15. I never entered the dining car.
suspects.alibiProof: Three passengers' tickets in carriage four are punched between 1:14 and 1:18.

suspects.name: Agnes Whitlow
suspects.testimony: I was napping in my sleeper cabin during the tunnel. I woke up when we came out.
suspects.alibiProof: The cabin door lock log shows it stayed shut from 1:05 to 1:30.

suspects.name: Silas Crane
suspects.testimony: I was snapping photos of the mountain view from my window seat at 1:15. It was lovely.
suspects.contradiction: His camera has no photos from 1:08 to 1:26, and salt dust was on his cuff.
